title: phone_lease fair FIFO queue
objective: Sessions that find a phone scope taken get a ticket and are granted in arrival order; dead sessions' leases and tickets are dropped at once; a whole-phone hold ends 30 s after its first grant.
acceptance_criteria: python_pkg/phone_lease tests pass with 100% branch coverage (test_fifo, test_alive, test_queue_props plus the old suites)
CLI: a second owner on a held package exits 3 with its place in line; another package is granted in parallel; the queued owner gets the lease after release
the CLI keeps exit 3 for a held scope, which phone_deploy_launch.sh depends on
out_of_scope: Changing the CLI exit code to QUEUED_EXIT (75)
verifier: python_pkg/phone_lease/tests and the CLI run in the evidence file
